name: Terrain gallery (p303, p304, p305)
description: The toolkit's terrain texture library, one isolated 12 × 12 m block per texture set (rows from the back: sand and mud, rocks and cliffs, snow and ice, grass and concrete), each drawn by the toolkit's terrain material (p305, its JSON route; one layer, world tiling) in the set's default packing, which the debug tab switches to the code route or to the baseline textureSetSurface (they look the same). Each block is a generated terrain with gentle 0.4 m noise and its back edge raised into a 35° ramp; the cliff blocks have a 6 m wall (tiled at its UVs in metres). Behind the library, the Anti-tiling row (p305): three flat 48 × 48 m grass01 blocks with the terrain material's anti-tiling NONE, DUAL_SCALE and HEX, the macro variation (macroNoise) on, which the debug tab switches and tunes. Left of the library, the Splatting row (p305): six 24 × 24 m generated blocks blending several sets by weights painted in code, the vertex colour (RGBA, 5 layers) and a splat map (5 layers) each LINEAR beside HEIGHT, RGB_AO with the vertex AO (4 layers), and 9 layers with two splat maps (code route materials, storage AUTO: the splat blocks bind one texture too many for SEPARATE, so each takes a set array the scene lists), which the debug tab tunes. In front of the library, the Rules row (p305): two 64 × 64 m blocks on one generated terrain with a cliff band, their layers laid by procedural rules (grass, rocks by slope, snow by height and north facing, cliffs on steep faces, macroNoise breaking the borders), the rules alone beside a splat map's sandy path and mud under the same rules (its six sets a set array the scene lists), which the debug tab tunes. Right of the library, the Procedural row (p304): the toolkit's ten surface generators on a block each (five rows of two), baked at the load (1024² LITE), which the debug tab switches between the bake, the generator live in the material and an imported set of its category, with each generator's params, its export and a GPU measurement. The DAY_NIGHT sky stands still at 10:00 and lights the scene.
